title: Hospital General Information
publisher: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Provider Data Catalog
note: Dataset last modified 2026-10-26. Used for hospital names, addresses, counties, CMS Certification Numbers and the Overall Hospital Quality Star Rating (1 to 5 stars; null where CMS shows "Not Available"). All 61 New Jersey hospitals of type "Acute Care Hospitals" are included.

title: Census Geocoder (Public_AR_Current benchmark)
note: Hospital coordinates from the CMS street address.

title: Nominatim search
note: Used for the 10 hospitals whose CMS address the Census Geocoder could not match. Each result was checked to be a hospital at the CMS street address or in the CMS city. Data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.

title: 2024 Gazetteer Files: ZIP Code Tabulation Areas
note: ZIP centroids are ZCTA internal points. ZIP codes with no ZCTA (for example PO-box-only ZIPs) are not included.

title: 2020 ZCTA to County Relationship File
note: Each ZCTA is assigned to the county holding the largest share of its land area.

title: 2027 New Jersey Individual Health Benefits Plans and Rates, effective 01/01/2027 - 12/31/2027
publisher: New Jersey Department of Banking and Insurance
note: Used for plan names, carrier, plan type, metal level, HSA compatibility (footnote 7) and marketplace availability. Plans marked with footnote 8 ("not available in all counties") are left out; the plans included here carry no such footnote.

title: Understanding Your OMNIA Health Plan
publisher: Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey
note: States that OMNIA doctors and hospitals are grouped into Tier 1 and Tier 2 and that both tiers are in network.

title: Doctor & Hospital Finder
publisher: Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey
note: Public (not signed in) search. Each hospital's profile was opened and its full "Plans Accepted" list read. The profile's record ID contains the hospital's CMS Certification Number, which was matched to the CMS record. OMNIA tier (Tier 1 or Tier 2) was not captured.

title: NJ health insurance plan comparison
note: Regional Preferred plans are listed without tiered cost sharing; AmeriHealth Advantage and Hospital Advantage plans show Tier 1 and Tier 2.

title: Find providers in your individual/family plan network
note: The page links a separate provider search for each individual network. The "Regional Preferred EPO/PPO Network" search was opened without signing in; it showed the plan as "Amerihealth PPO/EPO (Regional Preferred)". A search for "Acute Care Hospital" within 25 miles of New Brunswick, NJ returned 36 listings. A listing was matched to a CMS hospital only when its street address matched the CMS address. The directory footer showed "Last updated: 11/15/2026". Each hospital's own "plans accepted" list was not opened.

title: NPPES NPI Registry, monthly data dissemination file (November 2026)
note: Clinicians are active individual NPIs whose primary taxonomy is 208000000X (Pediatrics). The practice address is the primary practice location the clinician reported to the registry, which can be out of date. A location's practice name is the legal name of a pediatric organization NPI at the same street address. 21 of 168 locations could not be geocoded and are left out.

title: Find providers: Regional Preferred EPO/PPO Network, Pediatrics
note: Public (not signed in) search of the Regional Preferred EPO/PPO Network for the specialty "Pediatrics" within 10 miles of New Brunswick, NJ: 307 results, of which 298 doctor listings (MD or DO) were read. Listings do not show the doctor's own NPI; the NPI on a profile belongs to the practice location. A listing was matched to a registry pediatrician only when first name, last name, street number and street, and ZIP all agree. Name matches at a different address were left unknown. Checked for the 66 pediatricians within 5 miles of ZIP 08901.
